description: A key highlight of the partnership is the proposed AI-enabled management system for Simhastha 2028, aimed at transforming the global religious gathering into a technology-driven mega event.
body_lead: In a major push towards AI-led governance and digital transformation , the Madhya Pradesh government has partnered with Google to develop an AI-powered framework for Simhastha 2028 and establish an Artificial Intelligence Center of Excellence ( AI CoE ) in the state. The collaboration follows discussions held during the India AI Impact Summit 2026 between Google executives and Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav.
